# truenas_mail_config (Data Source)

Reads the current `mail` settings. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `fromemail` (String) The sending address that the mail server will use for sending emails.
- `fromname` (String) Display name that will appear as the sender name in outgoing emails.
- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.
- `oauth` (String) OAuth configuration for email providers that support it or `null` for basic authentication. JSON-encoded.
- `outgoingserver` (String) Hostname or IP address of the SMTP server used for sending emails.
- `port` (Number) TCP port number for the SMTP server connection.
- `security` (String) Type of encryption.
- `smtp` (Boolean) Whether SMTP authentication is enabled and `user`, `pass` are required.
- `user` (String) SMTP username.
